summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2116468220185981019))** breaks down *Trajectory2Gym* by Hu et al. ([arXiv 2610.33568](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.33568)), which synthesizes tool-use training data for compositional dependency coverage and decision grounding (excluding actions based on info the learner could not see) and weights SFT per trajectory; across five Qwen3 sizes the Tau1/Tau2/BFCL mean rose 16.9–29.8 points.

referenced_urls.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents

relevance: Better synthetic data for tool-use agents.
